notes.title: Simple Update for the Easter Egg Hunt
notes.notes:
Just some simple things...
Added the Easter Egg Hunt, with 20 eggs, and a special price if you can complete it.

Change the way you get help.
Now you can press H in the different menus to see a little help message.
If you do in the game scene, you get the whole beginner help screen. 

I have change the order, how the list on the right side is made.
Now the 'News' is at the bottom, and goes up, so it is easier to see, what just happened.

notes.title: Update Beta 1.6, Options + Feedback
notes.notes:
Added Gore, You can have Blood splatter when you hit an enemy.
Added WayPoints options, so you can remove icons, making it more of a Challenge to find things.
Added FastTravel Options, so you can limit how easy it is to travel.

Feedback things:
Added Stafe options, So you can change between Rotating and Moving sideways with A/D.
Added a break, so it is harder to run through walls.
Added a CheckSum, so you can't edit the Save Game file.
Added a small sound, when you pick up things, so you get audio feedback.
Added that you can also use Arrows and NumPad Arrows to move.
Change how the player touches things, so it is easier to interact with objects.
Expanded the Jump height to 150%, so it is easier to get up stairs.

Added two new mounts, you can ride.
A Stegosaurus, and a Bronze Dragon.
Change three potions, so now you get a random mount, monster or Element, when making those potions. 
(Make a +6 Str 'Conjure Mount' potions and you might get a bronze dragon... for a time.)

notes.title: Making a small patch for the Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
This was just a minor update, for the steam next fest.

I have made trees with fruit and small Plow furrow with vegetables.
If you eat fruits or vegetables you heal a little, but they also gives you other health things.
Apples and Watermelons gives extra health, Citrus adds mana. Small amounts but...

The Orc towns has gotten orcs, and small fields outside them.
(No Quests in that map yet.)

You can sit and fish or sit a few places.
You can sleep in beds, and that will make you heal very fast.
